L106: 【39†Music Bank】 Chart winners (2023)
L107: ---
L108: Highlights
L109: ---
L110: Song with most wins  | "Crazy Form" by 【40†Ateez】 (3)
L111: Artist(s) with most wins  | Ateez (6)
L112: Song with highest score  | "【41†God of Music】" by 【42†Seventeen】 (16,281)
L113: 【43†Image: Seventeen receiving their cultural award.†thumb.wikimedia.org】【42†Seventeen】's (pictured) win for "【41†God of Music】" had the highest score of 2023, with 16,281 points on the November 3 broadcast.
L114: The Music Bank Chart is a 【44†record chart】 established in 1998 on the South Korean 【45†KBS】 television 【46†music program】 【39†Music Bank】. Every week during its live broadcast, the show gives an award for the best-performing 【47†single】 on the South Korean chart.
L115: Since the episode on January 6, 2024, the chart utilizes digital performances on domestic online music services (60%), number of times the single was broadcast on KBS TV, radio and digital channels (20%), global pre-vote derived from the Mubeat app (10%),^{【48†[1]】} album sales (5%), and a social media score calculated using 【49†YouTube】 and 【50†TikTok】 data gathered from the 【51†Circle】 chart (5%)^{【52†[2]】} in its ranking methodology.^{【53†[3]】} The score for domestic online music services is calculated using data from 【54†Melon】, 【55†Bugs】, 【56†Genie Music】, 【57†Naver Vibe】 and Flo.^{【58†[4]】}
L116: Actor 【59†Lee Chae-min】 and 【60†Ive】 member 【61†Jang Won-young】 had been hosting the show together since September 30, 2022.^{【62†[5]】} 【63†Nmixx】 member Haewon appeared as a guest host on the first broadcast of the year in lieu of Won-young.^{【64†[6]】} Won-young went on to leave the show on January 13, 2023, after hosting the show for 1 year and 4 months.^{【65†[7]】} For the next three weeks 【66†NewJeans】 member 【67†Minji】 and 【68†Oh My Girl】 member Mimi appeared as guest hosts alongside Chae-min.
L117: 【69†Le Sserafim】's Hong Eun-chae was announced as the new co-host of the show on February 10, 2023.^{【70†[8]】} Since then, 【71†Dahyun】,^{【72†[9]】} NewJeans' 【73†Hanni】,^{【74†[10]】} 【75†Arin】,^{【76†[11]】} 【77†Kim Se-jeong】,^{【78†[12]】} 【79†TXT】's Choi Soo-bin,^{【80†[13]】} and 【81†Umji】^{【82†[14]】} have appeared as guest hosts in lieu of Eun-chae.
L118: In 2023, 42 singles achieved number one on the chart, and 30 acts were awarded first-place trophies. "【41†God of Music】" by 【42†Seventeen】 had the highest score of the year, with 16,281 points on the November 3 broadcast. 【40†Ateez】's "Crazy Form" won three trophies, making it the most awarded song of the year. Ateez had three number-one singles on the chart in 2023 achieved with "Halazia", "Bouncy (K-Hot Chilli Peppers)", and "Crazy Form".
L119: The three songs spent a total of six weeks atop the chart, making Ateez the act with the most wins of the year. 【83†Boy group】 【84†The Boyz】 also had three number-one singles on the chart achieved with "Roar", "Lip Gloss", and "Watch It". In addition to Ateez and The Boyz, eight other acts had more than one single ranked number one on the chart in 2023.
L120: 【85†Girl groups】 NewJeans and 【86†STAYC】 had two number-one singles on the chart achieved with "【87†Ditto】" and 【88†OMG】", and "【89†Teddy Bear】" and "【90†Bubble】", respectively.
L121: Six boy groups ranked two singles at number one on the chart in 2023: TXT with "【91†Sugar Rush Ride】" and "Chasing That Feeling", 【92†NCT 127】 with "Ay-yo" and "Fact Check", Seventeen with "【93†Super】" and "God of Music", 【94†Enhypen】 with "Bite Me" and "Sweet Venom", 【95†Stray Kids】 with "【96†S-Class】" and "【97†Lalalala】", and 【98†Exo】 with "【99†Cream Soda】" and "【100†The First Snow】".
L122: Ten acts achieved their first number one on Music Bank in 2023.
L123: "【101†Rover】", "【102†Killin' Me Good】", and "【103†Perfume】" helped 【104†solo artists】 【105†Kai】 and 【106†Jihyo】 and boy group 【107†NCT DoJaeJung】 gain their first ever music show awards on the March 24, August 25 and September 29 broadcasts, respectively.^{【72†[9]】}^{【108†[15]】}^{【109†[16]】} 【110†BSS】 and 【111†Tempest】 achieved their first number ones on the chart with "【112†Fighting】" and "Vroom Vroom", respectively.^{【113†[17]】}^{【114†[18]】} 【115†BTS】 members 【116†Jimin】, 【117†V】, and 【118†Jungkook】 gained their first solo number ones on the chart with "【119†Like Crazy】", "【120†Slow Dancing】", and "【121†Seven】", respectively.^{【122†[19]】}^{【123†[20]】}^{【124†[21]】} The former two went on to rank number one for two weeks on the chart.
L124: 【125†Blackpink】's 【126†Jisoo】 achieved her first number one on Music Bank on the April 14 broadcast with "【127†Flower】".^{【128†[22]】}

L129: 【110†BSS】 (top), 【107†NCT DoJaeJung】 (middle) and 【111†Tempest】 (bottom) received their first major broadcast music show wins with their Music Bank trophies for "【112†Fighting】", "【103†Perfume】" and "Vroom Vroom", respectively.
L130: 
L131: 【98†Exo】's 【105†Kai】 and 【130†Twice】's 【106†Jihyo】 received their first ever music show award trophies at Music Bank as solo artists with "【101†Rover】", and "【102†Killin' Me Good】", respectively.
L132: 【125†Blackpink】's 【126†Jisoo】 (top left), 【115†BTS】' 【116†Jimin】 (top right), 【117†V】 (bottom left) and 【118†Jungkook】 (bottom right) received their first Music Bank trophies as solo artists with "【127†Flower】", "【119†Like Crazy】", "【120†Slow Dancing】" and "【121†Seven - Clean Ver.】", respectively.
